arguments.sql: SELECT products.name AS Prodotto, SUM(order_lines.quantity) AS Quantità, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Importo FROM order_lines JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id JOIN orders ON order_lines.order_id = orders.id WHERE products.line = 'Tooling' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY products.name

arguments.subject: Report Tooling 2026
arguments.body: Ecco il foglio con quantità e importi per i prodotti della linea Tooling ordinati nel 2026.

with_the_gate.answer: Fatto: report Tooling 2026 salvato in /acme/documents/reports/report_7.xlsx e inviato a Stefano Riva.
